title: Birth in Algiers and musical family
summary: Bocage gives his birthdate and says his father Paul played guitar in a small band; brothers Henry (bass) and Charlie (banjo) were also musicians.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I was born in 1887, the 31st day of July, right here in Algiers.
Did any of your family play instruments, your daddy or anybody?
Yes, I had a, my father played a guitar and my brother, he's two brothers, they're both musicians too, you know.

Paul, Paul. Who did he play with, Peter? Well he played, he used to have a band, Old Man Dorset they call it years ago, they had, he didn't use over three or four pieces then, you know, violin, trumpet and guitar and bass, violin, you know. And how about your brothers, what were their names? Henry, he's a bass player, he's in Oakland. And Charlie, he's a banjo player, you know. He's downtown then, over in the city, you know.
